scope: Post-baseline optimization-budget follow-up on the same 42-qubit six-facility/six-customer instance and native Nighthawk patch. Existing outcomes are known. No population scaling claim or replacement of earlier fixed-budget results.
half_target: Keep the exact same accepted half-target MPS as the primary fitting reference. Construct a bond-256 tighter-cutoff target separately and report overlap/fidelity sensitivity for the baseline and selected new fits.
initialization: Half L6: continue the archived L6 best exactly, perturb it by 0.005 and 0.02, and extend/perturb the archived L2 fit. Half L10: four identity extensions of the best verified L6 among archived and new fits, with the declared perturbations. Full L6: best half-L6 exactly/perturbed for starts 0/1, and the independently fitted full product exactly/perturbed for starts 2/3.
full_target: Construct bond-128/256/512 references independently with cutoff 1e-12, retaining each checkpoint and failure. Accept the smallest adjacent pair with overlap >=0.999. No full fitting if no pair qualifies. This tests numerical convergence, not an exact-state certificate.
acceptance: Independent ansatz bond overlap >=0.999 and objective/independent-overlap discrepancy <2e-5. Keep every completed evaluation checkpoint and every failed/unverified attempt. The 0.98 primary accuracy threshold is unchanged.
parallelism: At most four independent workers, one physical core and one numerical thread each, under one aggregate 40 GiB RSS watchdog and 8 GiB system reserve. Each worker inherits a 32 GiB address cap. Depth dependencies remain sequential.
hardware: This follow-up measures classical fitting fidelity. No QPU submissions are part of this protocol. Report any >=0.98 circuit as eligible for a separately specified device validation.
